title: I run a browser gaming website and recently opened it up to indie and AI game developers
author: Spaceman1997z
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been running [ShortcutGames.com](http://ShortcutGames.com), an independent browser gaming website, for quite some time. It has grown to around 1,000 games and attracts players from around the world.

I recently introduced a Community Games section where developers can upload and publish their own HTML5 games completely free of charge.

It's still a relatively small platform, but I think that's actually an advantage for indie developers. On larger platforms like [itch.io](http://itch.io), it's easy for a new game to get buried among thousands of other releases. On a smaller platform like mine, your game has a better chance to stand out and get noticed.

Recently published games appear directly on the homepage, and the most liked community game gets a special featured spot.

Whether you're creating games with AI or developing them from scratch, I'd love to see your creations on the platform.

I'm also open to suggestions and feedback from developers. I'd love to build something that benefits both players and game creators.

[https://shortcutgames.com](https://shortcutgames.com)
